pairs.question: Quid potestas?
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-question and answer. Context just established the distinction 'inter doctrinam apostolorum et potestatem ... Disciplina hominem gubernat, potestas adsignat,' so 'potestas' has a referent. Dropped the discourse connective 'Sed rursum' framing the renewed question and capitalized 'Quid'. In the answer, the editorial supplement angle brackets around <Spiritus> are stripped, keeping the word per the brackets rule; the answer ends at the full stop after 'Deus' (next sentence 'Quid autem docebat?' turns to a new question).
